get_keywords.name: get_keywords
get_keywords.description: Get keywords data from Serpstat > Keyword Analysis.

query.description: The search query to find keywords for

se.description: Search engine to use for keyword analysis

minusKeywords.description: List of keywords to exclude from the search

withIntents.description: Include keyword intent (works for g_au and g_us only)

sortField.description: Field to sort by (any numeric fields in response data)

aiMetadata.description: Look up organic keyword data (search volume, CPC, competition, etc.) that a given seed keyword ranks for on a chosen search engine/region, via Serpstat keyword analysis. Use to research the keyword landscape around a term; supports excluding minus-keywords, sorting, pagination, and an advanced JSON filter for narrowing results. Read-only and idempotent.

get_suggestions.name: get_suggestions
get_suggestions.description: Get keyword suggestions from Serpstat > Keyword Analysis.

keyword.description: The keyword to get suggestions for.

se.description: Search engine to use for suggestions.

size.description: Number of results per page in response.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch search suggestions related to a given keyword (full-text matches that include the seed term) on a chosen search engine/region, via Serpstat keyword analysis. Use to discover related or long-tail keyword variants for ideation; supports pagination and an advanced JSON filter. Read-only and idempotent.
